title: Make LTE Uu stats and graph work for NR too
description:
N.B. Application of filters currently not working in
tap_parameter_dialog.cpp

Have changed existing tap names "mac-lte" and "rlc-lte" to
mean "mac-3gpp" and "rlc-3gpp - these now refer to both LTE an NR.
Have also, for now, left LTE-specific filenames for files
that can also now also deal with NR.

There will likely be several follow-up commits to address
pre-existing issues noticed in the statistics and graph
dialogs.

One issue, that I think may be dealt with later, is that for NR RLC UM, whole data SDUs do not have a sequence number. So in this graph screenshot, lots of data PDUs apparently have SN=0...
I added a flag to indicate whether the SN is there.  If no, the tap from that RLC PDU is ignored by the RLC graph tap.
If there is no fragmentation, there may be nothing to show in the graph at all!

changed this line in [version 6 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13542/diffs?diff_id=863965629&start_sha=8a94a245b4a612c119704f587b464d4b3e6954b3#1456094afccdca150acfc1f9102dae79823cbc75_42_0)

Done.  Have set MAX_NACKs to 512 for now - care is taken not to exceed the limit.  Luckily, for NR, it will include the NACK first and the range is whatever fits underneath, so it should be obvious which range has been NACKd in most cases.
NR RLC supports 18 bits SN so it must be changed

Would changing the tap name be a real deal breaker? I wonder if anyone else is using it outside of the GUI, and anyway the tap structure changed so it is not backward compatible anyway.

The only place it is exposed externally is that tshark supports -z mac-lte,stat   and -z rlc-lte,stat

What do you think - change them to mac-3gpp and rlc-3gpp ?
If we can filter on the rat parameter, we could maybe have both the LTE and NR variant. But maybe this is overkill and a rename would be ok.
If we have a way to filter on the rat field, maybe we could introduce mqc-nr and rlc-nr also. Or maybe it's not worth the trouble an we could go with the rename. Not sure what's best.

commits_data.message:
Make LTE UU stats and graph work for NR too

N.B. Application of filters currently not working in
tap_parameter_dialog.cpp

Have kept existing tap names "mac-lte" and "rlc-lte" to
mean both LTE an NR. I can't think of a better approach.
Have also, for now, left LTE-specific filenames for files
that can also now deal with NR.

Once this change is finalised, will need to update tshark
man page, other docs, wiki.

There will likely be several follow-up commits to address
pre-existing issues noticed in the statistics and graph
dialogs.
